name: Villa Adriana (Tivoli)
description: Emperor Hadrian built this sprawling retreat around AD 120, in the hills near Tivoli, about 20 km from Rome. Over 30 buildings, pools and fountains spread across terraces and gardens, covering more ground than Pompeii. Look for the daring curved concrete architecture that later inspired Borromini, and remember that much of the estate is still unexcavated.
